title: Authorization for Self-Modifying AI Agent Populations: Conserving Authority across Replacement, Forking, and Rollback
abstract: arXiv:2610.00347v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Self-modifying AI agents can replace, fork, and roll back identity-bearing software while descendants remain executable. Per-successor authorization does not constrain the resulting population: siblings may duplicate quotas, combine permissions, survive ancestor cuts, or overlap predecessors during promotion. We define authorization succession, which conserves authority across the active frontier of a single-parent generation forest.   Our external protocol binds each generation to a manifest, root, unique parent, complete lineage, and fresh population sequence. Separate invariants bound root-lifetime consumption and current population exposure. A staged reservation freezes predecessor residual authority during replacement, while a partitioning fork validates the complete child family. translated_title: 自修改AI智能体群体的授权机制：在替换、分叉与回滚中保持权限守恒
translated_abstract: 自修改AI智能体可以在后代保持可执行的状态下，对承载身份的软件进行替换、分叉和回滚。逐个后继者进行授权无法约束由此产生的智能体群体：兄弟个体可能重复配额、合并权限、在祖先被裁剪后仍然存活，或在晋升过程中与前辈重叠。我们定义了“授权继承”这一概念，它在单亲代际森林的活动前沿上保持权限守恒。我们的外部协议将每一代绑定到清单、根、唯一父代、完整谱系以及新鲜的种群序列。相互独立的不变式分别约束根生命周期内的总消耗和当前种群的风险暴露。分阶段的预留机制在替换过程中冻结前辈的残余权限，而分区式分叉则验证完整的子代家族。每次提交都以原子方式隔离前辈并激活后继者。祖先裁剪会使依赖其后代失效；回滚则会创建一个全新的代际。
tldr: 该论文提出“授权继承”机制及配套外部协议，确保自修改AI智能体在替换、分叉和回滚操作中权限守恒，防止智能体群体中出现配额重复、权限合并或越权存活等失控风险。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "authorization succession," an external protocol that conserves authority across replacement, forking, and rollback of self-modifying AI agents, preventing quota duplication, permission combination, and unauthorized survival within agent populations.
